// Standalone evidence collector: copy beside a fresh sass-parser installation.
// No sorter, Prettier, postcss-scss or repository modules are loaded.
const fs = require("node:fs");
const { createHash } = require("node:crypto");
const { createRequire } = require("node:module");
const path = require("node:path");
const parser = require("sass-parser");
const candidateRequire = createRequire(require.resolve("sass-parser"));
const sass = candidateRequire("sass");
function versionOf(name) {
    let directory = path.dirname(candidateRequire.resolve(name));
    for (;;) {
        const file = path.join(directory, "package.json");
        if (fs.existsSync(file)) {
            const metadata = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
            if (metadata.name === name) return metadata.version;
        }
        const parent = path.dirname(directory);
        if (parent === directory) throw new Error("Package metadata not found: " + name);
        directory = parent;
    }
}

const cases = [
    { id: "keyframes-percentages", input: "@keyframes spin {0% {opacity:0} 100% {opacity:1}}\n" },
    {
        id: "branch-comment",
        input: "@if true {.a{width:1px}} /* keep branch */ @else {.a{width:2px}}\n",
        marker: "keep branch"
    },
    { id: "footer-comment", input: ".a { width: 1px; /* keep footer */ }\n", marker: "keep footer" },
    { id: "ignored-subtree", input: "// prettier-ignore\n.ignored { z-index: 1;   color : red; }\n", selector: ".ignored" },
    { id: "leading-whitespace", input: ".probe {z-index:1;\n\n/* for color */\ncolor:red;}\n", selector: ".probe" },
    { id: "control", input: ".control { width: 1px; height: 2px; }\n" },
    { id: "keyframes-from-to-control", input: "@keyframes spin {from {opacity:0} to {opacity:1}}\n" },
    {
        id: "footer-explicit-semicolon-control",
        input: ".a { width: 1px; /* keep footer */ }\n",
        marker: "keep footer",
        forceSemicolon: true
    }
];
const comments = root => {
    const result = [];
    root.walkComments(node => result.push({ type: node.sassType, text: node.text }));
    return result;
};
function sourceSpan(node) {
    const start = node.source?.start?.offset,
        end = node.source?.end?.offset;
    return {
        start: start ?? null,
        end: end ?? null,
        // sass-parser 0.5.6 spans are end-exclusive. Record this observation;
        // a future adapter must verify conventions before slicing changed ASTs.
        sliceEndExclusive: Number.isInteger(start) && Number.isInteger(end) ? node.source.input.css.slice(start, end) : null
    };
}
const rows = cases.map(test => {
    // A failure here is a broken reproduction, not evidence against the parser.
    sass.compileString(test.input, { logger: sass.Logger.silent });
    const row = { ...test, validSass: true };
    try {
        const root = parser.scss.parse(test.input);
        row.initialComments = comments(root);
        if (test.selector) {
            const node = root.nodes.find(node => node.selector === test.selector);
            row.originalSpan = sourceSpan(node);
            row.children = node.nodes.map(child => ({
                type: child.sassType,
                name: child.prop ?? child.text,
                before: child.raws.before ?? null,
                source: sourceSpan(child)
            }));
        }
        if (test.forceSemicolon) root.nodes[0].raws.semicolon = true;
        row.first = root.toString();
        row.firstComments = comments(parser.scss.parse(row.first));
        row.second = parser.scss.parse(row.first).toString();
        row.third = parser.scss.parse(row.second).toString();
        row.stable = row.first === row.second;
        row.stableSecondToThird = row.second === row.third;
        if (test.marker) {
            row.markerInInitialAST = row.initialComments.some(comment => comment.text.includes(test.marker));
            row.markerInFirstPrint = row.first.includes(test.marker);
            row.markerInReparsedAST = row.firstComments.some(comment => comment.text.includes(test.marker));
            row.markerInSecondPrint = row.second.includes(test.marker);
            row.markerInThirdPrint = row.third.includes(test.marker);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        row.error = { name: error.name, message: error.message };
    }
    return row;
});
console.log(
    JSON.stringify(
        {
            schemaVersion: 1,
            migrationApproved: false,
            candidate: {
                version: versionOf("sass-parser"),
                entrySHA256: createHash("sha256")
                    .update(fs.readFileSync(require.resolve("sass-parser")))
                    .digest("hex"),
                sass: sass.info,
                postcss: candidateRequire("postcss/package.json").version,
                node: process.version
            },
            rows
        },
        null,
        2
    )
);
